activeBuild.description: Persistent cursor placement + rotation: when MOVE is selected and an asset is picked, it stays attached to the cursor with a translucent preview (green valid / red invalid), highlights the selected asset, left-click places it, keeps the asset selected for repeat placement; ESC/right-click cancels. Rotation 90°/45°/15°/free with keyboard shortcuts, so houses can face pathways. NEXT per the user's approved order and the user's 'Start' message.

buildHistory.description: Chickens wandering loosely around the town in the 3D world — peck, wander, scuttle aside; wild animals still keep out.
Clean 3D play screen — banner and diagnostic/help words into Options, compact status strip, Hide UI toggle.
Sprint button hold + tap-to-toggle, robust multi-touch hold, no-op slide pin fix.
Minecraft-style blocky characters — big square heads, goofy faces, hats on nearly everyone.
Sprint shakiness fix — perpendicular wall-slide + exhaustion rearm gate.
Tired-state shakiness fix — tap-to-move slide stall + press-while-tired rearm hole. (Re-trigger commit 00a3f115: deploy job failed, same content.)
Path cobbles/slabs render whole-world — no more pop at the detail-window edge.
Zoom out twice as far in 3D mode — orbit max 32 to 64 (first-person pitch flip rode along in BUILD 1022's commit).
Grass and little details render farther + infinite world past the old edge. (Re-trigger commit e49d3521: deploy job stuck, same content.)
Rocks placeable + removable in Build mode.
Sprint actually works — wider tap window, persistent latch, Release! label, half the rebuild stutter.
Water — a basic ocean west of town, placeable in Build mode.
Walls removable + in the Build menu; Sprint is a small icon next to Gold.
Saved chunks keep the inn, blacksmith, and general store.
Tap-to-walk pathfinding (player A* + NPC pathing fixes). Landed: commit 9dc4cdf7, deploy run 42428294182 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Distant wild lakes render as their real shape: far cells now scan the whole cell so a lake subdivides into its actual tiles instead of painting the whole cell blue; the lake stays put as the player walks. Landed: commit 336741da, deploy run 42431099076 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

House interiors keep you inside: the walls are solid now — you can only leave through the Exit button (or the E key), which puts you back on the doorstep, and you can walk straight back in again. Landed: commit 7d1c8cf9, deploy run 42432401556 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Red sports car: tap the Car button and it appears next to you, Enter Car (or E) to get in, drives at 10x walking speed, Exit Car (or E) to step out — the car stays parked. Session-only (not saved). Landed: commit 7a9671d4, deploy run 42434904636 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Ashfall Stage 2 terrain: rolling hills (visual-only heightfield), stronger ground tint, shores (sand band + foam edge), stone revived on high ground. Heightfield SHIPPED (not the fallback). Walkability unchanged. Landed: commit 62354ebf, deploy run 42438231684 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Car lag fix: the world rebuild is now time-sliced across frames while moving (10ms/frame) and ~50% cheaper, so driving is smooth with no stutter at chunk boundaries. The world renders exactly as before (identical vertex counts). Landed: commit 452da72b, deploy run 42441522022 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

buildQueue.description: Persistent cursor placement + rotation: when MOVE is selected and an asset is picked, it stays attached to the cursor with a translucent preview (green valid / red invalid), highlights the selected asset, left-click places it, keeps the asset selected for repeat placement; ESC/right-click cancels. Rotation 90°/45°/15°/free with keyboard shortcuts, so houses can face pathways.
Yellow drag rectangle to select an entire area; move/rotate/delete/duplicate/enhance/adjust everything inside it together, preserving relative spacing and rotations.
Command-based undo/redo history covering placement, deletion, movement, rotation, scaling, and area operations. CTRL+Z / CTRL+Y + dedicated buttons. Never silently discard history.
Lanterns, bushes, windmill, mine, ore deposits, bridge tile, more buildings/trees/roads/decorations in the Build menu, organized into categories.
Doors facing pathways, trees off paths, lanterns along roads, fences around properties, alignment helpers. Optional tools, not automatic changes.

An Import Hub in the Build Menu for external 3D models/textures/asset packs/audio/ZIP/folders, a local file import pipeline, an AI asset-access layer. A separate staged program after the Town Builder. Honest limits: no direct local-folder access on iPhone Safari; ChatGPT cannot access local files without an upload.
Vegetation: 3 tree shapes, bushes (non-blocking), crates/stalls stop rendering as trees, grass density re-tested vs FPS.
Architecture: roof variety (axis/pitch/parapet), gardens/fences, interior ceilings + hearth glow; no mechanics (inn/store/smith stay shells).
Settlements: market stalls at the plaza, readable districts, 2-3 fixed wild landmarks; second settlement explicitly out of scope.
Atmosphere: night that reads as night + stars, dawn/dusk grading, staggered evening lights; weather + sun-follow shading are stretch, not promised.
One bounded repo task: permanent GitHub-synced dashboard data (studio/dashboard/), reconcile build history vs commits, four quality gates with real evidence, atomic-write memory protection.
